name: soundspan-repo
description: Repo-level orchestration for the soundspan packages (backend, frontend, media-metadata-contract). Not a published package and deliberately NOT an npm workspace: each package keeps its own lockfile so the per-package Docker image builds and CI caching stay intact (GH #8; full workspace conversion is a tracked follow-up).

scripts.setup: npm --prefix packages/media-metadata-contract install && npm --prefix packages/media-metadata-contract run build && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup:ci: npm --prefix packages/media-metadata-contract ci && npm --prefix packages/media-metadata-contract run build && npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.format: npm --prefix packages/media-metadata-contract run format && npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format && backend/node_modules/.bin/prettier --write scripts healthcheck-prod.js docker-bake.json package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: status=0; npm --prefix packages/media-metadata-contract run format:check || status=1; npm --prefix backend run format:check || status=1; npm --prefix frontend run format:check || status=1; backend/node_modules/.bin/prettier --check scripts healthcheck-prod.js docker-bake.json package.json .prettierrc.json || status=1; exit $status
scripts.verify: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:frontend && npm run verify:helm && npm run verify:gates
scripts.verify:ci: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:frontend && npm run verify:python && npm run verify:python-quality && npm run verify:helm && npm run verify:gates
scripts.verify:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:component && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.verify:python: pytest services/tidal-downloader/tests -q && pytest services/ytmusic-streamer/tests -q && pytest services/audio-analyzer/tests -q && pytest services/audio-analyzer-clap/tests -q && pytest tests/ -q
scripts.verify:python-quality: ruff check services/ && ruff format --check services/ && mypy && MYPYPATH=services mypy services/tidal-downloader/app.py services/tidal-downloader/tests && MYPYPATH=services mypy services/ytmusic-streamer/app.py services/ytmusic-streamer/yt_download.py services/ytmusic-streamer/tests && MYPYPATH=services mypy services/audio-analyzer/analyzer.py && MYPYPATH=services mypy services/audio-analyzer-clap/analyzer.py
scripts.verify:gates: node scripts/ci/check-route-error-canon.mjs && npm run check:error-canon:test && npm run check:override-staleness && npm run check:override-staleness:test && npm run check:infra-release:test && node --test scripts/ci/dockerfile-hygiene.test.mjs && npm --prefix frontend run lint:hex && npm --prefix backend test -- --maxWorkers=2 src/config/__tests__/openapiRouteSync.test.ts && npm run format:check
